accepted.s: Which organisation designed the Tejas Light Combat Aircraft, and which organisation built it?
o: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited; Aeronautical Development Agency
Aeronautical Development Agency; Hindustan Aeronautics Limited
accepted.x: The Tejas LCA was designed by the Aeronautical Development Agency and built by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited.
accepted.tq: Test the developer–builder distinction rather than identifying only the aircraft.
accepted.sec: Aircraft - developer or origin, role, numbers  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. LCH Prachand — High-altitude light combat helicopter
2. HTT-40 — Basic turboprop trainer
3. Do-228 — Light transport and maritime patrol aircraft
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All three pairs are correctly matched. Prachand is a high-altitude light combat helicopter, HTT-40 is a basic turboprop trainer, and Do-228 serves light transport and maritime patrol roles.
accepted.tq: Split the options by checking each aircraft’s role.
accepted.sec: Aircraft - developer or origin, role, numbers  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Do-228 operated by India is based on a design originating from which country and is licence-built by HAL at which location?
accepted.x: The Do-228 is based on a German Dornier design and is licence-built by HAL at Kanpur.
accepted.tq: Use the origin–production-location combination to distinguish similar transport aircraft.
accepted.sec: Aircraft - developer or origin, role, numbers  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: C-17 Globemaster III — Boeing, United States
C-130J Super Hercules — Lockheed Martin, United States
accepted.x: The IL-76 was developed by Ilyushin of Russia. Dassault of France developed the Rafale.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped developer–aircraft pair.
accepted.sec: Aircraft - developer or origin, role, numbers  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The C-295 aircraft programme involving Airbus and Tata is associated primarily with which role?
accepted.x: The C-295 is a medium tactical transport aircraft produced through cooperation between Airbus of Spain and Tata.

accepted.s: The first ‘Made in India’ C-295 is scheduled to roll out in which year?
accepted.x: The first Made-in-India C-295 is scheduled to roll out in 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the year-specific numerical recall pattern.

accepted.s: Lakshya, developed by DRDO’s Aeronautical Development Establishment, is a:
o: Light combat helicopter for high-altitude operations
Pilotless target drone used for weapon tests
accepted.x: Lakshya is a pilotless target drone developed by DRDO-ADE for weapon testing.

accepted.s:
With reference to the LCA Mk1A contract announced in 2025, consider the following statements:
1. The contract covers 97 aircraft.
2. It includes 68 fighters and 29 twin-seaters.
3. The contract value is ₹62,370 crore.
4. It was signed on 25 September 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The 2025 HAL contract covers 97 LCA Mk1A aircraft, comprising 68 fighters and 29 twin-seaters, at a value of ₹62,370 crore, and was signed on 25 September 2025.
accepted.tq: Check each numerical and date statement independently before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Aircraft - developer or origin, role, numbers  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the delivery schedule and indigenous-content features of the 97-aircraft LCA Mk1A contract?
o: Deliveries begin in 2028–29 over ten years, with over 75% indigenous content and MF-STAR radar.
Deliveries run from 2027–28 over six years, with over 64% indigenous content and the UTTAM AESA radar.
Deliveries begin in 2026–27 over four years, with 50% indigenous content and a Russian radar.
Deliveries run from 2025–26 over three years, with over 80% indigenous content and MRSAM radar.
accepted.x: Deliveries are scheduled from 2027–28 over six years. The aircraft have over 64% indigenous content and use the UTTAM AESA radar.
accepted.tq: Separate the correct year, duration, indigenous-content figure and radar from nearby defence specifications.
accepted.sec: Aircraft - developer or origin, role, numbers  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The 2025 contract for LCA Mk1A aircraft came after which earlier order?
accepted.x: The 97-aircraft contract followed the earlier order for 83 LCA Mk1A aircraft.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the later order from the preceding procurement figure.
accepted.sec: Aircraft - developer or origin, role, numbers  [APPSC]

accepted.s: INS Vikrant is correctly described as:
o: India’s first indigenous aircraft carrier, IAC-1, built by Cochin Shipyard
A Project 15B destroyer built by Garden Reach Shipbuilders
India’s first nuclear ballistic-missile submarine, built by Mazagon Dock
A Project 75 submarine built by Hindustan Shipyard
accepted.x: INS Vikrant is India’s first indigenous aircraft carrier, designated IAC-1, and was built by Cochin Shipyard.
accepted.tq: Match the platform with its project identity and builder.
accepted.sec: Naval platforms - class, type, builder; commissionings  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Kalvari class:
1. It is associated with Project 75.
2. The submarines are diesel-electric Scorpene-class submarines based on a French design.
3. Six boats are planned or built under the programme.
4. INS Vaghsheer is the last boat of the class.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The Kalvari class belongs to Project 75, comprises six French-design Scorpene diesel-electric submarines, and INS Vaghsheer is the last boat.
accepted.tq: Verify the project, propulsion, number and terminal vessel separately.
accepted.sec: Naval platforms - class, type, builder; commissionings  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the correct composition of Project 15B destroyers?
accepted.x: Project 15B comprises the Visakhapatnam-class destroyers Visakhapatnam, Mormugao, Imphal and Surat.
accepted.tq: Use the class roster to distinguish destroyers from frigates and submarines.
accepted.sec: Naval platforms - class, type, builder; commissionings  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Project 15B ships are best described as:
o: Diesel-electric submarines built by Hindustan Shipyard
Multi-mission frigates built jointly by GRSE and Cochin Shipyard
Stealth guided-missile destroyers built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders
accepted.x: Project 15B consists of Visakhapatnam-class stealth guided-missile destroyers built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders.
accepted.tq: Identify the project by combining vessel type, stealth role and builder.
accepted.sec: Naval platforms - class, type, builder; commissionings  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about the Nilgiri class is/are correct?
1. It is associated with Project 17A.
2. Seven multi-mission stealth frigates are included in the class.
3. The ships use CODOG propulsion and can exceed 28 knots.
4. BrahMos and MRSAM/Barak-8 are among the specified weapon systems.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Project 17A consists of seven multi-mission stealth frigates with CODOG propulsion, speeds above 28 knots, and systems including BrahMos and MRSAM/Barak-8.
accepted.tq: Break a dense platform description into project, number, propulsion, speed and weapon features.
accepted.sec: Naval platforms - class, type, builder; commissionings  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Nilgiri-class frigates are being built by:
accepted.x: The Nilgiri-class Project 17A frigates are being built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders and Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers.
accepted.tq: Test the joint-builder relationship.
accepted.sec: Naval platforms - class, type, builder; commissionings  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes Varunastra?
o: An indigenous heavyweight anti-submarine torpedo designed by NSTL, Visakhapatnam
A submarine sonar integrated by DRDO-NMRL
A lightweight helicopter-launched torpedo designed by ARDE, Pune
An anti-torpedo decoy system developed by GRSE, Kolkata
accepted.x: Varunastra is an indigenous heavyweight anti-submarine torpedo designed by NSTL at Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the heavyweight torpedo from decoys, sonar and lightweight torpedoes.
accepted.sec: Naval platforms - class, type, builder; commissionings  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Naval system)
A. TAL
B. Maareech
C. USHUS
D. ERASR

List-II (Description)
1. Integrated submarine sonar
2. Anti-submarine rocket

accepted.s:
TAL torpedoes can be launched from which of the following platforms?
1. MH-60R helicopters
2. ALH Dhruv helicopters
3. P-8I aircraft
4. INS Vikrant only
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: TAL is launched from MH-60R and ALH Dhruv helicopters and from P-8I aircraft. It is not restricted to INS Vikrant.
accepted.tq: Reject the exclusive ‘only’ claim and identify the actual launch platforms.
accepted.sec: Naval platforms - class, type, builder; commissionings  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): An Air Independent Propulsion system allows a diesel-electric submarine to remain submerged for extended periods without snorkelling.
Reason (R): The DRDO-NMRL system uses fuel-cell technology to provide underwater endurance.

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both statements are true, and the fuel-cell-based DRDO-NMRL system explains how AIP extends submerged operation without snorkelling.
accepted.tq: Check whether the reason directly explains the operational advantage stated in the assertion.
accepted.sec: Naval platforms - class, type, builder; commissionings  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement regarding the Indian AIP system is correct?
o: It is a nuclear propulsion system developed by NSTL for SSBNs.
It was developed by DRDO-NMRL and has been cleared for retrofit in diesel-electric submarines.
It is based on a Russian partnership and is used only in aircraft carriers.
It enables submarines to remain submerged only while snorkelling continuously.
accepted.x: The AIP system was developed by DRDO-NMRL using fuel-cell technology and has been cleared for retrofit in diesel-electric submarines.
accepted.tq: Use the authority and propulsion-type traps to eliminate swapped descriptions.
accepted.sec: Naval platforms - class, type, builder; commissionings  [APPSC]

accepted.s: INS Arihant is India’s first:
o: Indigenous torpedo launch and recovery vessel

accepted.s: INS Astradharini is best described as a:
o: Torpedo launch and recovery vessel used to trial DRDO underwater weapons
Project 17A stealth frigate armed with BrahMos
Survey vessel operated by Garden Reach Shipbuilders
Nuclear ballistic-missile submarine used for deterrence patrols
accepted.x: INS Astradharini is an indigenous torpedo launch and recovery vessel used for trials of DRDO underwater weapons; it was commissioned in 2024 at Visakhapatnam.

accepted.s:
Which of the following naval platforms were delivered in 2025?
1. INS Surat
2. INS Nilgiri
3. INS Udaygiri and INS Himgiri
4. INS Vaghsheer
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four were delivered in 2025: Surat under Project 15B, Nilgiri, Udaygiri and Himgiri under Project 17A, and Vaghsheer as the last Project 75 submarine.

Agray, Malwan, Anjadip, Sanshodhak, Sanghmitra and Shachi
Cheetah, Guldar, Kumbhir, Tamal, Surat and Imphal

o: Private shipyard jointly owned by Airbus and Tata
Ministry of Defence public sector undertaking
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways undertaking

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders — Mumbai — builds destroyers, P17A frigates and Scorpene submarines
GRSE — Kochi — builds only aircraft carriers
Goa Shipyard — Kolkata — builds Scorpene submarines
Cochin Shipyard — Visakhapatnam — builds Adamya-class fast patrol vessels

accepted.s: Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers is located at:
accepted.x: Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers, commonly abbreviated as GRSE, is located in Kolkata.
accepted.tq: Test the location of a named defence shipyard directly.
accepted.sec: Shipyards - location, ownership, FIRST  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which Indian shipyard was the first Indian yard to export a warship, sending one to Mauritius in 2014?
accepted.x: GRSE was the first Indian shipyard to export a warship; the export to Mauritius took place in 2014.
accepted.tq: Identify the ‘FIRST’ achievement and its export destination.
accepted.sec: Shipyards - location, ownership, FIRST  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement about GRSE is correct?
o: It is a private yard that delivered its first warship to Mauritius in 2025.
It is a Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways yard that built INS Vikrant alone.
It built India’s first ship in 1948 and is headquartered at Visakhapatnam.
It has built 118 warships, including 80 for the Indian Navy, and delivered three platforms simultaneously for the first time in March 2026.
accepted.x: GRSE has built 118 warships, of which 80 were for the Indian Navy, and in March 2026 delivered three platforms at once for the first time.
accepted.tq: Check the high-risk production numbers and milestone date together.
accepted.sec: Shipyards - location, ownership, FIRST  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Cochin Shipyard is under which ministry and is associated with which distinction?
o: Ministry of Home Affairs; builder of Scorpene submarines
Ministry of Heavy Industries; first exporter of a warship
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways; builder of INS Vikrant and India’s largest shipyard
Ministry of Defence; India’s oldest shipyard
accepted.x: Cochin Shipyard is under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways. It built INS Vikrant and is India’s largest shipyard.
accepted.tq: Separate ministry ownership from the shipyard’s major construction achievement.
accepted.sec: Shipyards - location, ownership, FIRST  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with Goa Shipyard?
o: Vasco da Gama, Goa; defence PSU that builds Adamya-class fast patrol vessels for the Coast Guard
Mumbai; builds only commercial cargo ships
accepted.x: Goa Shipyard is located at Vasco da Gama in Goa, is a defence PSU, and builds Adamya-class fast patrol vessels for the Coast Guard.
accepted.tq: Use the location–ownership–product combination to identify the shipyard.
